description: Add Rails-style lifecycle callbacks (beforeSave, afterSave, beforeCreate, afterCreate, beforeUpdate, afterUpdate, beforeDestroy, afterDestroy) to ActiveRecordJS models.

userStories.title: Define hook type interfaces
userStories.description: As a developer, I want TypeScript interfaces for hooks so that I have type safety when defining callbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: BeforeHook<T> and AfterHook<T> types defined in types.ts
Hook types support async functions
Hook types receive model instance as parameter
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Add hook static properties to Model
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to declare hooks as static properties on my model class so that I can define callbacks declaratively.
acceptanceCriteria: Static properties: beforeSave, afterSave, beforeCreate, afterCreate, beforeUpdate, afterUpdate, beforeDestroy, afterDestroy
Each property accepts an array of hook functions
Subclasses can override parent hooks
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Implement beforeSave and afterSave hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want beforeSave to fire before any save operation and afterSave to fire after successful save so that I can transform data and trigger side effects.
acceptanceCriteria: beforeSave fires before both create and update
afterSave fires after successful save (both create and update)
Hooks receive model instance
Hooks can modify model attributes
Unit tests in hooks.test.ts pass
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Implement beforeCreate and afterCreate hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want beforeCreate/afterCreate to fire only for new records so that I can handle creation-specific logic.
acceptanceCriteria: beforeCreate fires before INSERT (new records only)
afterCreate fires after successful INSERT
Does NOT fire on update operations
Hook execution order: beforeSave -> beforeCreate -> INSERT -> afterCreate -> afterSave
Unit tests pass
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Implement beforeUpdate and afterUpdate hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want beforeUpdate/afterUpdate to fire only for existing records so that I can handle update-specific logic.
acceptanceCriteria: beforeUpdate fires before UPDATE (existing records only)
afterUpdate fires after successful UPDATE
Does NOT fire on create operations
Hook execution order: beforeSave -> beforeUpdate -> UPDATE -> afterUpdate -> afterSave
Unit tests pass
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Implement beforeDestroy and afterDestroy hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want beforeDestroy/afterDestroy hooks so that I can handle cleanup and logging on record deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: beforeDestroy fires before DELETE
afterDestroy fires after successful DELETE
Hook execution order: beforeDestroy -> DELETE -> afterDestroy
Unit tests pass
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Support async hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want hooks to support async functions so that I can perform async operations like API calls or additional DB queries.
acceptanceCriteria: Async hooks are awaited before proceeding
Multiple async hooks execute in sequence (not parallel)
Errors in async hooks propagate correctly
Integration tests with real async operations pass
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Hook abort capability
userStories.description: As a developer, I want beforeX hooks to be able to abort the operation so that I can implement conditional saves/deletes.
acceptanceCriteria: Throwing an error in beforeSave/beforeCreate/beforeUpdate aborts the operation
Throwing in beforeDestroy aborts deletion
Error is propagated to caller
After hooks do NOT fire when before hook aborts
Unit tests for abort behavior pass
Typecheck passes: bun run check

userStories.title: Integration tests for hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integration tests that verify hooks work with real database operations so that I have confidence in production behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: hooks.integration.test.ts created
Tests verify hooks fire in correct order with real DB
Tests verify data modifications in hooks persist
Tests verify abort behavior with real transactions
All integration tests pass
